mapper.sql: pay10_month_id AS month_id, pay10_company_id AS company_id, pay10_pay_cd AS pay_cd, pay10_date AS date, pay10_person_id AS person_id, COALESCE(pay10_work_day, 0) AS work_day, COALESCE(pay10_total_work_time, 0) AS total_work_time, COALESCE(pay10_extend_work_time, 0) AS extend_work_time, COALESCE(pay10_night_work_time, 0) AS night_work_time, COALESCE(pay10_holiday_work_time, 0) AS holiday_work_time, pay10_note AS note, pay10_std_month AS std_month, emp01_emp_no AS person_no, f_emp_kor_nm(pay10_person_id) AS person_nm, f_cdnm('EmpPosCode', emp03_pos_cd, emp01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS pos_nm, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay11_item_amt), 0) FROM pay11_month_item WHERE pay11_month_id = pay10_month_id AND pay11_item_type = '1') AS pay_sum, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay11_item_amt), 0) FROM pay11_month_item WHERE pay11_month_id = pay10_month_id AND pay11_item_type = '2') AS tax_ddc_sum, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay11_item_amt), 0) FROM pay11_month_item WHERE pay11_month_id = pay10_month_id AND pay11_item_type = '1') - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay11_item_amt), 0) FROM pay11_month_item WHERE pay11_month_id = pay10_month_id AND pay11_item_type = '2') AS deduction_sum
mapper.select: SELECT pay10_month_id AS month_id, pay10_company_id AS company_id, pay10_pay_cd AS pay_cd, pay10_date AS date, pay10_person_id AS person_id, COALESCE(pay10_work_day, 0) AS work_day, COALESCE(pay10_total_work_time, 0) AS total_work_time, COALESCE(pay10_extend_work_time, 0) AS extend_work_time, COALESCE(pay10_night_work_time, 0) AS night_work_time, COALESCE(pay10_holiday_work_time, 0) AS holiday_work_time, pay10_note AS note, pay10_std_month AS std_month, NULL::varchar AS person_no, NULL::varchar AS person_nm, NULL::varchar AS pos_nm, NULL::numeric AS pay_sum, NULL::numeric AS tax_ddc_sum, NULL::numeric AS deduction_sum FROM pay10_month WHERE pay10_company_id = #{companyId} AND pay10_month_id IN #{id}
SELECT f_create_4insure_adjust_modi(#{personId}, #{insureCode}, #{payDate})
SELECT f_create_seq()
SELECT count(*) FROM emp01_person WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp01_person_id = #{personId}

SELECT COALESCE(pay01_basic_pay, 0) AS basic_pay, COALESCE(pay01_over_pay, 0) AS over_pay, COALESCE(pay01_etc01_pay, 0) AS etc01_pay, COALESCE(pay01_etc02_pay, 0) AS etc02_pay, COALESCE(pay01_meal_pay, 0) AS meal_pay, COALESCE(pay01_car_mt, 0) AS car_mt, COALESCE(pay01_childcare_allowance, 0) AS childcare_allowance FROM pay01_annual WHERE pay01_company_id = #{companyId} AND pay01_person_id = #{personId} AND pay01_start_date IN ( SELECT MAX(a.pay01_start_date) FROM pay01_annual a INNER JOIN apr01_appr b ON a.pay01_appr_id = b.apr01_appr_id WHERE a.pay01_person_id = #{personId} AND b.apr01_status_cd = '30' AND a.pay01_start_date <= #{payDate} ) ORDER BY pay01_start_date DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay10_month (pay10_month_id, pay10_company_id, pay10_pay_cd, pay10_date, pay10_person_id, pay10_work_day, pay10_total_work_time, pay10_extend_work_time, pay10_night_work_time, pay10_holiday_work_time, pay10_std_month) VALUES (#{monthId}, #{companyId}, #{payCode}, #{payDate}, #{personId}, #{workDay}, #{totalWorkTime}, NULL, NULL, NULL, #{stdMonth})
INSERT INTO pay11_month_item (pay11_month_item_id, pay11_month_id, pay11_item_type, pay11_item_cd, pay11_item_amt) VALUES (#{monthItemId}, #{monthId}, #{itemType}, #{itemCode}, #{itemAmt})
mapper.select: SELECT f_calc_4insure_nps(#{personId}, #{payDate})
SELECT f_calc_4insure_hi(#{personId}, #{payDate}, 'true')
SELECT f_calc_4insure_ltc(#{personId}, #{payDate})
SELECT f_calc_4insure_ei(#{personId}, #{payDate})
SELECT f_calc_income_tax(#{monthId})
SELECT f_calc_local_tax(#{payDate}, f_calc_income_tax(#{monthId}))
SELECT f_create_4insure_adjust_pay(#{personId}, #{insureCode}, #{payDate})

SELECT t.pay10_month_id AS month_id, t.pay10_date AS date, t.pay10_pay_nm AS pay_name, t.pay10_deduction_sum AS deduction_sum, t.pay10_pay_sum AS pay_sum, t.pay10_income_tax_sum AS income_tax_sum FROM ( SELECT pay10_month_id , pay10_date , f_cdnm('PayMonthCode', pay10_pay_cd, pay10_company_id, pay10_date) AS pay10_pay_nm , SUM(COALESCE(pay11_item_amt,0) * CASE WHEN pay11_item_type = '2' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END) AS pay10_deduction_sum , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_type = '1' THEN COALESCE(pay11_item_amt,0) ELSE 0 END) AS pay10_pay_sum , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_cd = '250' THEN COALESCE(pay11_item_amt,0) ELSE 0 END) AS pay10_income_tax_sum , pay10_company_id , pay10_pay_cd FROM pay10_month INNER JOIN pay11_month_item ON pay11_month_id = pay10_month_id WHERE pay10_company_id = #{companyId} AND pay10_person_id = #{personId} AND to_char(pay10_date,'yyyy') = #{year} GROUP BY pay10_company_id, pay10_month_id, pay10_date, pay10_pay_cd ) t LEFT JOIN pay05_relate_appr ON ( pay05_company_id = pay10_company_id AND pay05_start_date = pay10_date AND pay05_pay_cd = pay10_pay_cd AND ( ( pay05_pay_cd = '03' AND pay05_retire_id = pay10_month_id ) OR ( pay05_pay_cd != '03' ) ) ) LEFT JOIN apr01_appr ON ( apr01_appr_id = pay05_appr_id AND COALESCE(apr01_status_cd,'99') = '30' ) WHERE 'Y' = CASE WHEN t.pay10_date <= f_today() THEN 'Y' WHEN apr01_appr_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ORDER BY t.pay10_date DESC, t.pay10_pay_cd

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT * FROM pay10_month LEFT OUTER JOIN pay11_month_item ON pay10_month_id = pay11_month_id INNER JOIN pay20_item ON pay11_item_cd = pay20_item_cd INNER JOIN emp01_person ON pay10_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN emp02_others ON pay10_person_id = emp02_person_id ) t WHERE pay10_month_id = #{monthId} AND pay11_item_amt != 0 AND pay11_item_type = #{itemType}

SELECT emp01_emp_no AS person_no , f_emp_kor_nm(pay10_person_id) AS person_name , f_cdnm('EmpPosCode', emp03_pos_cd, emp01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS pos_name , pay11.code110, pay11.code111, pay11.code112, pay11.code113 , pay11.code120, pay11.code121, pay11.code122, pay11.code123 , pay11.code130, pay11.code140, pay11.code190 , pay11.code210, pay11.code220, pay11.code221, pay11.code230, pay11.code231 , pay11.code240, pay11.code241, pay11.code250, pay11.code251, pay11.code260, pay11.code261 , ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay11_item_amt), 0) FROM pay11_month_item WHERE pay11_month_id = pay10_month_id AND pay11_item_type = '1' ) AS pay_sum , ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay11_item_amt), 0) FROM pay11_month_item WHERE pay11_month_id = pay10_month_id AND pay11_item_type = '2' ) AS tax_ddc_sum , ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay11_item_amt), 0) FROM pay11_month_item WHERE pay11_month_id = pay10_month_id AND pay11_item_type = '1' ) - ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay11_item_amt), 0) FROM pay11_month_item WHERE pay11_month_id = pay10_month_id AND pay11_item_type = '2' ) AS deduction_sum , pay10_work_day AS work_day , pay10_total_work_time AS total_work_time , pay10_extend_work_time AS extend_work_time , pay10_night_work_time AS night_work_time , pay10_holiday_work_time AS holiday_work_time FROM pay10_month INNER JOIN emp01_person ON pay10_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN emp02_others ON pay10_person_id = emp02_person_id INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON pay10_person_id = emp03_person_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT pay11_month_id , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_cd = '110' THEN pay11_item_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code110 , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_cd = '111' THEN pay11_item_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code111 , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_cd = '112' THEN pay11_item_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code112 , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_cd = '113' THEN pay11_item_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code113 , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_cd = '120' THEN pay11_item_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code120 , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_cd = '121' THEN pay11_item_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code121 , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_cd = '122' THEN pay11_item_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code122 , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_cd = '123' THEN pay11_item_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code123 , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_cd = '130' THEN pay11_item_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code130 , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_cd = '140' THEN pay11_item_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code140 , SUM(CASE WHEN (pay11_item_cd NOT IN ('110','111','112','120' ,'121','122','130','140') AND pay11_item_type = '1') THEN pay11_item_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code190 , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_cd = '210' THEN pay11_item_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code210 , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_cd = '220' THEN pay11_item_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code220 , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_cd = '221' THEN pay11_item_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code221 , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_cd = '230' THEN pay11_item_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code230 , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_cd = '231' THEN pay11_item_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code231 , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_cd = '240' THEN pay11_item_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code240 , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_cd = '241' THEN pay11_item_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code241 , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_cd = '250' THEN pay11_item_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code250 , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_cd = '251' THEN pay11_item_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code251 , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_cd = '260' THEN pay11_item_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code260 , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_cd = '261' THEN pay11_item_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code261 FROM pay11_month_item GROUP BY pay11_month_id ORDER BY pay11_month_id ) pay11 ON pay11.pay11_month_id = pay10_month_id WHERE (emp03_person_id, emp03_trans_date) IN ( SELECT emp03_person_id, MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp01_person INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp03_trans_date <= #{payDate} GROUP BY emp03_person_id ) AND pay10_company_id = #{companyId} AND pay10_date = #{payDate} AND pay10_pay_cd = #{payCode} ORDER BY emp01_emp_no

SELECT SUM(pay11.pay_sum) AS pay_sum , SUM(pay11.tax_ddc_sum) AS tax_ddc_sum , SUM(pay11.pay_sum)-SUM(pay11.tax_ddc_sum) AS deduction_sum FROM pay10_month INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON emp03_person_id = pay10_person_id AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = pay10_person_id AND emp03_trans_date <= #{payDate} ) INNER JOIN ( SELECT pay11_month_id , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_type = '1' THEN pay11_item_amt ELSE 0 END) AS pay_sum , SUM(CASE WHEN pay11_item_type = '2' THEN pay11_item_amt ELSE 0 END) AS tax_ddc_sum FROM pay11_month_item GROUP BY pay11_month_id ORDER BY pay11_month_id ) pay11 ON pay11.pay11_month_id = pay10_month_id WHERE pay10_company_id = #{companyId} AND pay10_date = #{payDate} AND pay10_pay_cd LIKE #{payCode}
